name: Beginning of Hierarchical Transaction
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837.5010.X222.A1.xml — new segment for Phase 2, all 6 positions required, no N (Not Used) positions to drop. BHT01 is fixed to '0019' by the IG (structure code for this HL hierarchy), BHT06 to 'CH'/'RP' (Chargeable/Reporting) — not modeled as fixedValue since these are genuine per-occurrence business values a caller must supply, not transaction-set-identity constants (contrast ST01/GS01/GS08, see X12TransactionSetDef's own doc comment).
